principles.one_transport_owner: A materially moving recursive army or standalone formation uses one compact aggregate transport owner, never one object per wagon or cart team.
principles.cargo_custody: Food, fodder, ammunition and engineering stores remain in formation logistics ledgers. The transport owner references those stocks and never duplicates them.
principles.transport_capacity: Depot carts are treated only as aggregate wagon-equivalent transport capacity. Allocation conserves that capacity; the train stores one capacity number and one condition factor rather than serviceable/damaged/destroyed cart ledgers.
principles.service_duty: Transport work consumes a derived fraction of already-conserved formation personnel. Drivers and baggage guards are Unit Duties, not separate bodies or persistent job species.
principles.camp: Camp state stores one physical footprint, readiness time and cargo references. Kitchens, latrines, medical tents, pickets and baggage sectors are derived when needed rather than persisted as separate subowners.
